laws.rule: Pelister National Park, open all year: daily entry MKD 100 per visitor; car or motorbike MKD 150; van up to 20 seats MKD 250; bus MKD 450. Parking only in marked zones (car MKD 150). (No RBA rate for MKD; at the National Bank of the Republic of North Macedonia rate of 30 October 2026, A$1 = about 38.8192 MKD: MKD 100 ≈ A$2.58; MKD 150 ≈ A$3.86; MKD 250 ≈ A$6.44; MKD 450 ≈ A$11.59)
